items.title: 8.3 Macroscopic aur microscopic waqiat ka taalluq (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.3, printed page 170.

blocks.text: Macroscopic waqiat bohat se ek saath hone wale microscopic waqiat ka nateeja hain, to microscopic waqiat samajhna equilibrium system mein dekhi gai macroscopic tabdeeliyon ko samjhane aur un ka andaza lagane mein madad karta hai. Jab equilibrium badalta hai to dekhi gai tabdeeliyon ko samjhane wale microscopic waqiat zarraat ke darmiyan takrao aur naye bonds ka banna hain; yeh takrao forward aur reverse reactions ki rates badalte hain, jo activation energy aur bairooni awamil se mutasir hoti hain, aur mil kar nangi aankh se nazar aane wali macroscopic tabdeeliyon ke taur par zahir hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Equilibrium dynamic nau'iyat ka hai. Microscopic waqiat ke lihaz se wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Equilibrium par nazar aane wali koi cheez nahi badalti, magar reactants ke molecules ab bhi takra rahe, bonds tor rahe aur products bana rahe hain, aur products ke molecules ab bhi takra kar reactants dobara bana rahe hain. Yeh mukhalif microscopic amal bilkul barabar rates se chalte hain, to un ka macroscopic nateeja, mixture ki tarkeeb, mustaqil rehta hai jabke molecular sargarmi kabhi nahi rukti.

items: Macroscopic tabdeeliyan bohat se microscopic waqiat ka majmooa hain; equilibrium ki tabdeeli takrao aur bond banne se samjhai jati hai jo forward aur reverse rates badalte hain.
